test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Chocolate can be ______ without milk; mix cocoa butter, sugar and a puree of fermented, roasted cocoa beans, and you ______ a perfectly respectable dark chocolate.
solution:
The correct answer is '**made; have**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• The verb "**made**" is the past participle form of the verb "**make**."

• The sentence describes a process that results in a product ("**dark chocolate**"), so the past participle "**made**" is required.

• **Options 1, 2**, and 3 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Chocolate can be **made**__ without milk; mix cocoa butter, sugar and a puree of fermented, roasted cocoa beans, and you __**have**__ a perfectly respectable dark chocolate."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Option 1: "make; have"** is incorrect because "can be make" is not grammatically correct.

• **Option 2: "making; have"** is incorrect; "can be making" is not grammatically correct.

• **Option 3: "made; has"** is incorrect because "you has" is not grammatically correct.
